name: Dragon Citadel
description: IMPORTANT: AFTER INSTALLING THE MOD IN VCMI, RUN INSTALL BILLADENC4 RUNTIME.CMD ONCE TO ENABLE ALL ENGINE FEATURES. Dragon Citadel is an expensive endgame town with elite golems, titans, ancient dragons and the original level 8 Ultimate Dragon line. The BILLADENC4 runtime also enables Ruby Golem round growth and makes Ultimate and Absolute Dragons appear only once every 8 weeks. The mod will continue to grow with GitHub updates.
author: Billaden

1.5.5: Fixed the critical creatureLevel8 identifier error that caused VCMI to reject and disable the mod.
Rebuilt the town presentation with larger, terrace-grounded structures and clearer adventure-map fortification stages.
Added an animated Grail storm cloud with black-crimson and white-violet lightning, producing 10,000 extra gold and 10 of every resource daily.
Locked Ultimate Dragon recruitment behind the Grail and set the final recruitment costs to 150,000 gold plus 150 of every resource, or 220,000 gold plus 200 of every resource for the upgrade.
Removed the artificial glow and outline from Dragon Citadel creature portraits.
Replaced the borrowed Dungeon siege set with dedicated Dragon Citadel walls, scenery and animated dragon-head firing turrets.
Bundled an elevated one-click BILLADENC4 runtime installer with automatic detection of a standard VCMI installation.
Removed the separate level 8 town and adventure-map sanctuaries; the Grail now activates both final dragon recruitment entries automatically.
1.5.4: Locked every adventure-map town stage to the original Dragon Citadel stone, turquoise and gold palette regardless of player color.
Added dedicated blank owner-color overlays for Village, Fort, Citadel, Castle and Capitol, including scaled VCMI rendering.
Color-corrected the original village and fort selection portraits for stronger blue, gold, contrast and sharpness without replacing their artwork.
Added dedicated Ultimate and Absolute Dragon takeoff, wing-flapping flight and landing frames.
Added four-frame directional attack and damage reactions for both final dragons, including their special breath attack groups.
Animated the Ultimate Dragon's black fire with a dark crimson core and the Absolute Dragon's white-violet Voidfire with a black center.
Removed all retaliations from Ultimate and Absolute Dragons as an endgame balance nerf.
Rebalanced the fully developed town screen into a castle-led hierarchy by compacting dwellings, utility buildings and special structures while keeping every building functional and clickable.
Moved both level 8 sanctuary stages from the center of town into the lower river below the stairs, including matching click and hover masks.
Added fitted level 8 portraits and dedicated animated recruitment previews so both final dragons remain fully visible without shrinking their battle animations.
Prepared the release for direct installation into the active VCMI mod directory.
1.5.3: Finished the Ruby Golem with its own ruby battle animation, map animation and creature portraits.
Implemented cumulative Ruby Golem growth after every completed battle round: +2 Attack, +1 Defense and +10 Health.
Added a first-sentence runtime installation warning to the VCMI description and release instructions.
1.5.2: Capped level 8 town growth so Castle no longer raises Ultimate or Absolute Dragons to +3 in stock VCMI.
Changed the BILLADENC4 endgame rule from monthly level 8 growth to one dragon every 8 weeks.
Rebuilt Ultimate and Absolute Dragon battle sprites from a true flying animation set instead of sliding a mostly static icon.
1.5.1: Reduced level 8 dragon damage so they no longer delete armies in one hit.
Added Ruby Golems as a third golem upgrade, with BILLADENC4 round-scaling documented.
Added the Royal Dragon Mint upgrade for 5,000 gold and one of every resource per day.
Expanded English launcher text, screenshots, campaign planning files and creator trainer notes.
1.5.0: Added the entirely original level 8 Ultimate Dragon and its Absolute Dragon upgrade.
Added the Sanctuary at the End of Ages, its upgraded town structure and a guarded adventure-map dwelling.
Added original battle, portrait and adventure-map graphics based on the selected dragon concepts.
Added an optional BILLADENC4 runtime rule for one level 8 creature per month.
1.4.4: Rebalanced level 1 and 2 recruitment prices against comparable Heroes III creatures.
Nerfed both Titan forms, reduced their growth to 1 and raised their dwelling costs.
Raised recruitment costs for every super dragon and capped level 5-7 growth at 1 per week after building a Castle.
Replaced the reused Dragon Mint model with a unique forge-and-coin-press structure.
1.4.3: Rebuilt the town layout across natural terraces and grounded every structure.
Increased the fortification stages by 30% and the adventure-map town by 35%.
Added a polished HD portrait for every creature over the Dragon Citadel background.
Improved the Storm Dragon palette and refined the Azure Sanctuary and treasury positions.
1.4.2: Raised every dwelling and dwelling upgrade construction cost by 50%.
Raised recruitment costs for every creature by 20%.
Changed English to the base language and added a complete Polish translation.
1.4.1: Added a custom Dragon Citadel creature background.
Improved the Black Monk and Storm Titan portraits.
Brightened the faction icon and adventure-map town appearance.
Unified the town's Polish descriptions, costs and visual presentation.

polish.name: Smocza Cytadela
polish.description: WAŻNE: PO INSTALACJI MODA W VCMI URUCHOM RAZ INSTALL BILLADENC4 RUNTIME.CMD, ABY WŁĄCZYĆ WSZYSTKIE FUNKCJE SILNIKA. Smocza Cytadela oferuje elitarne golemy, tytanów, pradawne smoki i całkowicie autorską linię Smoków Ostatecznych poziomu 8. Runtime uruchamia także rozwój Rubinowego Golema po każdej rundzie oraz pojawianie się Smoka Ostatecznego raz na 8 tygodni.
polish.author: Billaden
